checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One approximately 10-second landscape video with music embedded
must.why: The assistant reports a 10.2 s 854x480 file, but the final muxed file wasn't provided. The audio file is 15 s, which is longer than the video.

must.item: Montage visibly includes neon signs, a moving train and wet street reflections at night
must.why: Frames show neon signs on a wet street with reflections, and a blurred elevated train at night. The puddle-reflection shot (7-10 s) was not among the frames, but shot 1 already shows wet reflections.

must.item: Upbeat electronic instrumental bed audible across the montage, no speech
must.why: The audio has sound at a -1 dB peak, but its content can't be judged from the numbers. Its 15 s length also doesn't match the 10 s video.

must.item: At least two distinct shot changes coincide with audible beats
must.why: The assistant admits the cuts fall at fixed times (3 s and 7 s) and are not beat-timed. Beat alignment is not verified.

must.item: No added titles, captions or subtitles
must.why: No overlay text appears in the frames. The only text is the neon sign lettering within the scene.

faults.what: Cuts were not timed to the beat, which was an explicit user requirement.
The audio is 15 s while the video is about 10 s, so the track may be uncut or mismatched. The final mix wasn't verified.
The neon sign lettering in shot 1 is garbled or mirrored, which is a typical AI artefact.
Shot 1 is a slow drift on a static street rather than a close-up of flickering signs. The film is 10.2 s rather than 10 s, and it is 480p.
The assistant never watched the video, and the third shot could not be verified from the supplied frames.

summary: The visuals are attractive and on-brief, with neon on a wet street and a speeding lit train. However, the cuts are not on the beat, as the user asked, and the music is unverified and 15 s long against a roughly 10 s video.
